name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムバルバトス用 拡張パーツセット
name.en: Expansion parts set for MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos

description.ja: 店頭販売アイテム ＭＳ本体（別売り）に組み合わせて、ガンダムバルバトスの各形態を再現可能な拡張パーツセットが登場！
description.en: In-store sales item Introducing an expansion parts set that can be combined with the MS body (sold separately) to reproduce various forms of Gundam Barbatos!

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ』より、”ガンダム・バルバトス”が装備した各武装形態を再現できる、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans ", you can reproduce each armed form equipped by " Gundam Barbatos".

description.ja: 武装とオプションパーツを拡張セットとして商品化。
description.en: Weapons and optional parts are commercialized as an expansion set.

description.ja: 1/100スケールとして初となるモビルワーカーが新規付属！オルガ・イツカのフィギュア(立ち)と新規デカールも同梱！
description.en: The first mobile worker for 1/100 Scale is newly included! Olga Itsuka figure (standing) and new decals are also included!

description.ja: ※ 当商品にＭＳ本体は付属しません。
description.en: *The MS body is not included with this product.

description.ja: ※各形態を再現するには、組み立て前の「ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムバルバトス」（別売り　店頭販売アイテム）が必要です。
description.en: *To reproduce each form, "MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos" (separately sold over-the-counter item) is required before assembly.

description.ja: ●　第１・２・３・５・５地上戦仕様・６形態を再現できる武装類とオプションパーツを新規造形で再現。
description.en: ● Weapons and optional parts that can reproduce the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 5th ground battle specifications and 6 forms are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ＭＧならではの密度と情報量を収めたディテールとギミックを搭載。
description.en: Equipped with details and gimmicks that contain the density and amount of information unique to MG.

description.ja: 第１形態
description.en: First form

description.ja: 両肩の装甲が外された状態。左腕の装甲とシールドを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The armor on both shoulders has been removed. The left arm armor and seal are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 第２形態
description.en: Second form

description.ja: 両肩のアーマーを新規造形。青と白のカラーリングを成形色で再現。
description.en: Newly sculpted armor on both shoulders. The blue and white coloring is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: 第３形態
description.en: Third form

description.ja: 特徴的な左腕のワイヤークロ―は、展開ギミックを搭載。
description.en: The characteristic wire claw on the left arm is equipped with an unfolding gimmick.

description.ja: 付属のリード線により射出シーンの再現が可能。
description.en: The injection scene can be reproduced using the included lead wire.

description.ja: 第５形態
description.en: Fifth form

description.ja: 地球降下作戦用の各装備を新規造形で再現。
description.en: Reproduce each equipment for the Earth descent operation with new modeling.

description.ja: シュヴァルベ・グレイズのものを流用した腰部ブースターはスラスター部の展開が可能。
description.en: The lumbar booster, which was adapted from Schwalbe Glaze's, has a thruster section that can be deployed.

description.ja: 腕部迫撃砲は射撃時の可動ギミックを再現。
description.en: The arm mortar reproduces the movable gimmick when shooting.

description.ja: 第５形態地上戦仕様
description.en: Fifth form ground battle specification

description.ja: ＭＳ本体ほどの長さのレンチメイスを新規に再現。連動ギミックにより開閉が可能。
description.en: A new reproduction of a wrench mace that is as long as the MS itself. Can be opened and closed by interlocking gimmick.

description.ja: 腕部機関砲と大型化された脚部を新規パーツで徹底再現。接地性を考慮したラバーシールが付属。
description.en: The arm cannon and enlarged legs are thoroughly reproduced with new parts. Comes with a rubber seal for better ground contact.

description.ja: 第６形態
description.en: 6th form

description.ja: 第５形態をベースに上半身に施されたアーマーの形状、カラーリングを新規パーツで立体化。
description.en: Based on the fifth form, the shape and coloring of the armor on the upper body have been made three-dimensional with new parts.

description.ja: 第６形態用の腰部ブースターを忠実に再現。
description.en: Faithfully reproduces the lumbar booster for the 6th form.

description.ja: ●　モビルワーカーが付属！
description.en: ● Mobile worker included!

description.ja: 1/100スケールのモビルワーカーを初立体化。2種類の武装を組み替え式で再現可能。
description.en: The first three-dimensional version of a 1/100 Scale mobile worker. Two types of weapons can be reproduced by rearranging them.

description.ja: 選択式で一般機、指揮官機を再現できるほか、コックピットの開閉ギミックを搭載。
description.en: In addition to being able to reproduce general aircraft and commander aircraft with a selection formula, it is equipped with a gimmick that opens and closes the cockpit.

description.ja: ●　新規造形のオルガ・イツカのフィギュア（立ち）が付属。
description.en: ● A newly sculpted Olga Itsuka figure (standing) is included.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属！
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included!

description.ja: 鉄華団のロゴに加え、ギャラルホルンやボードウィン家の紋章、ダメージ表現用デカールといったバラエティー豊かなマーキングを収録。
description.en: In addition to the Tekkadan logo, it includes a variety of markings such as Gjallarhorn, the Baudouin family emblem, and decals to express damage.

description.ja: 〈セット内容〉
description.en: <Set contents>

description.ja: 第１～第２形態用左腕パーツ ／ 第２～第３形態用肩装甲 ／ 第３形態用ワイヤークロー ／ レンチメイス ／
description.en: Left arm parts for 1st and 2nd forms / Shoulder armor for 2nd and 3rd forms / Wire claw for 3rd form / Wrench mace /

description.ja: 胸部反応装甲 ／ 腕部迫撃砲 ／ 腰部アーム ／ 第５形態用腰部ブースター ／ 第６形態用装甲 ／ 腕部機関砲 ／
description.en: Chest reactive armor / arm mortar / lumbar arm / 5th form lumbar booster / 6th form armor / arm machine gun /

description.ja: 第６形態用腰部ブースター ／ モビルワーカー ／ オルガ・イツカのフィギュア（立ち） ／ 水転写式デカール
description.en: Waist booster for 6th form / Mobile worker / Olga Itsuka figure (standing) / Water transfer decal

description.ja: １／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：１５才以上
description.en: Target age: 15 years old and above

description.en: Product material: PS/PVC/TPE

description.ja: ・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません。
description.en: ・No adhesive is used in the assembly.

description.en: This product has been expanded to "MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos" (separately sold over-the-counter item).

description.ja: 各（第１・２・３・５・５地上戦仕様・６）形態を再現するための、‘武装／パーツ類’のセットです。
description.en: A set of 'arms/parts' to reproduce each (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 5th ground battle specification, 6th) form.

description.ja: ※　当商品にＭＳ本体は付属しません。
description.en: *The MS body is not included with this product.

description.ja: ※　バルバトス各形態を再現するには、当商品と組み立て前の 「ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムバルバトス」（別売り）がそれぞれ必要です。
description.en: * To reproduce each form of Barbatos, this product and the pre-assembly "MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos" (sold separately) are required.
